newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Volume rose slightly to 2.9 billion yuan from 2.5 billion on Monday, with the seven-day contract the most active.
Traders said non-bank financial institutions lent out large amounts of money on the market today due to plunges on the domestic A share markets.

"Sharp falls on the A share markets in Shanghai and Shenzhen have made the short-term liquidity needs of the securities houses and brokers drop dramatically," said one trader. "They have turned into net lenders now from borrowers before."
The stock markets plunged in the past two days due to Beijing's unexpected crackdown starting on Monday.
Traders expect the rates to move narrowly in the near term.
